critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 846 lines - still growing; consider splitting into routers (avatars, brain, tokens, launch, lab, websocket) soon.
_brain_cache uses a hard cap of 2000 with FIFO eviction; works but under heavy load concurrent evictions could pop a pending future that another request is awaiting. Low risk given current scale.
brain_line stores asyncio futures by key with shield; if the underlying _brain_call raises after shield checks, the future itself may be re-awaited (returns cached result object fine). Good.

GATEWAYS fallback for IPFS is sequential and inside asyncio.Lock() - cold start on 3000 avatars first-model-fetch could be slow; warm_avatar_cache is referenced but should ensure it only pre-warms featured subset.
import_token calls _go_live even if the token is draft; no rate limiting - a malicious client could spam /tokens/import with random mints. Consider throttling by IP or wallet.
No cleanup on test-created tokens (QA* and imported CZJf...) - will accumulate across iterations. Minor.
